name: Roswell Park (weekly bolus 5-FU/LV)

drugs.name: Leucovorin
drugs.notes: DeVita Table 40.11 (Haller et al., 1998), line 123446/123450: LV 500 mg/m2 IV over 2 hr, given weekly for 6 consecutive wk, repeated every 8 wk. Not on NCCN tall man list (LEVOleucovorin, the levo isomer, is listed; plain leucovorin is not).

drugs.name: 5-Fluorouracil
drugs.notes: DeVita Table 40.11 (Haller et al., 1998), line 123446/123450/123451: 5-FU 500 mg/m2 IV bolus, given 1 hr into the LV infusion; weekly for 6 consecutive wk, repeated every 8 wk. Not on NCCN tall man list.

supportiveCare: Antiemetics: low emetic risk tier (NCCN appendix D: 10-30% frequency; bolus 5-FU is conventionally low risk); leucovorin is not emetogenic on its own
G-CSF: not indicated as routine prophylaxis; appendix C low-risk regimens are not given a specific FN risk designation on the NCCN Templates, physician discretion per patient factors

monitoring: CBC weekly during the 6-week treatment block (weekly dosing)

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Protocol-specific delay/reduce criteria may apply; physician decides.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
